Name: Larkspur Data-Tier Integrator
Description: What deploying and tearing down the Larkspur app stack needs in rg-lark-data, and nothing more: link vnet-lark to the private DNS zones, register private endpoint records, auto-approve private endpoint connections to SQL and Key Vault, attach the persistent managed identities, and point a diagnostic setting at log-lark (linked-scope check). Cannot change or delete the SQL server, database, Key Vault, secrets, identities or zones.
